title: Streamline GPU artifact resolution and symbol quarantine strategy
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: Over the last year we've observed flaky cold-start failures and symbol collisions across heterogeneous GPU hosts caused by non-deterministic artifact resolution and mixed-version shared objects. This ticket consolidates work to make runtime artifact selection deterministic, introduce a symbol quarantine layer to isolate new/untested kernel symbols at load time, and provide a lightweight delta-patch path to ship fixes without full image rollouts. Goals: 1) deterministic artifact ordering for kernel bundles; 2) quarantine new symbols at process start, with automatic promotion after health checks; 3) CI gates that validate symbol compatibility across a representative hetero fleet; 4) a delta-patch format and rollout/rollback flow for emergency fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic kernel artifact order implemented and configurable via config/runtime.artifact_order
Symbol quarantine layer rejects or isolates unknown exported symbols and records telemetry
End-to-end CI job that runs symbol compatibility checks across 3 representative container images and fails on regressions
Delta-patch packaging prototype that applies binary diffs to shared object bundles with a verified rollback path
No increase in median startup latency >5ms on canary hosts after quarantine enabled
Documented rollout playbook and runbook for applying delta patches with checklist
implementation_notes: Introduce artifact resolver that prefers signed bundles, then pinned-version bundles, then latest-compatible; resolver is deterministic by SHA sort when tie-breaking
Symbol quarantine implemented as a loader shim that maps unknown symbols to a proxy trampoline that replies with a specific error until promoted
Promotion policy: 24h healthy uptime and no symbol-related crashes in canary group -> auto-promote and remove quarantine
Delta-patch uses xdelta3 against signed bundle tarballs; apply uses verification with sha256 and signature check before hot-swap
To reduce overhead we run quarantine checks only on cold-starts; warm restarts skip symbol checks unless flagged
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Quarantine proxy could mask regressions; Mitigation: Surface detailed telemetry and block promotion if any telemetry shows degraded per-token latency
Risk: Delta patches could desynchronize images; Mitigation: require patch to carry parent-bundle hash and CI cross-validate against fleet fixtures
Risk: Increased startup latency; Mitigation: gating rollout behind latency experiments and only enabling on underutilized canaries first
testing_plan: Unit tests for artifact resolver ordering and fallback rules
Integration test of loader shim under qemu emulation of heterogeneous GPUs
Canary rollout with 5% of hosts in staging, monitor crash rate, per-token latency, and memory usage for 48h
CI matrix covers 3 CUDA versions, 2 Triton builds, and both quantized and fp16 model bundles
deployment_plan: Phase 1: Merge resolver + shim behind feature flag, deploy to staging; run CI matrix
Phase 2: Enable quarantine on staging canaries (5%), collect 72h telemetry
Phase 3: Enable delta-patch code path and run end-to-end apply/rollback tests
Phase 4: Progressive enablement to production (5% -> 20% -> 50%) with kill-switch and automated rollback policy
notes: Latest discussion on 2025-01-29: design simplified to avoid intercepting warm restarts to reduce risk; agreed with product that initial rollout should be opt-in per-customer
Feedback from security (Evelyn Chen) on 2025-01-31: require KMS-backed signature verification for delta patches — added to implementation notes
Infra (Marcus Lee) asked for measure hooks: added perf_benchmarks and must include memory RSS delta in next run
PR review comment: split resolver logic into separate package to make it easier to audit and test (see runtime PR #2891)
